conclusions.acquisition: Pre-stage death leaves no record or launched reader; pending/installed records block collection; owned pre-load recovery verifies exact records
conclusions.releaseIntent: Pre-unlink death leaves reader retained; matching retry completes release; post-unlink intent permits ACK-RELEASE-REPLAY; changed handles rejected
conclusions.collectionIntent: Death after retirement, first child deletion, root removal or completion recording keeps A fenced; resume removes remainder or acknowledges completion
conclusions.resumeGates: Revoked writer-quiescence flag rejects every collector resume until coordinator redeclares it; retired publication refused
conclusions.stateBinding: Collector recovery/replay does not change authoritative publication state; selected B runtime 43 after all four cases
conclusions.pathReappearance: Collected A path recreated in scratch fixture is refused and preserved, not deleted again

evidenceBoundary.death: 12 acknowledged SIGKILL checkpoints with host and filesystem still running; no power-loss/disk-restart claim
evidenceBoundary.acquisitionRecovery: Only owned acquisition operation that never returned a handle or launched any reader/children is cleaned; no generic dead-reader or TTL recovery
evidenceBoundary.release: Full-handle intent resolves identity but does not prove reader use ended; cooperative caller owns release authorization
evidenceBoundary.collection: Exact owned scratch roots, persistent retired/collected distinction, shared advisory lock and rechecked gates; writer declaration remains trusted assertion
evidenceBoundary.fixtureIsolation: Collector cases sequentially restore original scratch A bytes from owned backup after all operation processes ended and reader records released; no production path recycling protocol
evidenceBoundary.partialDelete: One explicit first top-level child removal checkpoint, not exhaustive syscall cut coverage
evidenceBoundary.durability: Intent, reader record, registry and filesystem deletion are separate operations; ordering under power loss or distributed storage not qualified
evidenceBoundary.open: Authentication, live-reader termination proof, writer-capability closure, alias replacement, tombstone cleanup/migration and full external runtime closure
evidenceBoundary.counts: 72 primary observations are 57 added recovery plus 15 repeated prerequisites; separate baseline retention run has 30 rerun observations; older historical probe counts not added
evidenceBoundary.scope: Only owned temporary storage changed; retained compiler patches, installed/candidate sources and deployment unchanged

nextContracts: Enforce and authenticate writer-capability closure before quiescence declaration
Trusted reader ownership/release and staging recovery authority
Storage durability and immutable path identity
Release tombstone lifecycle and interrupted schema/recovery migration
